judgments.reason: The paper describes Brainstorm, a general open-source software tool for multimodal electrophysiology data analytics, rather than introducing or describing the specific MEG-BIDS dataset.
The dataset README explicitly cites the candidate paper as the 'Brainstorm project seminal publication' and the paper describes the Brainstorm software used to process this MEG/MRI data.
judgments.paper_title: Brainstorm: A User-Friendly Application for MEG/EEG Analysis
